## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **Owner's 16-PHASE MANDATE (2026-07-20): rebuild IVX Owner AI as a real senior developer** — (1) 17-state task execution state machine, (2) 11 task-type classification, (3) 18-step senior-developer loop, (4) fix chat loading defect (7 areas A-G), (5) audit likely files, (6) fix false completion reporting, (7) 7-section narrative, (8) context pipeline with retrieval, (9) permanent system prompt rules, (10) separate execution from response, (11) 22-field structured execution record, (12) prevent duplicate worker reports, (13) 15 chat acceptance tests, (14) 6 IVX response tests, (15) 22-item required proof, (16) 16-section final response format
- **Owner's CERTIFICATION FIX MANDATE (2026-07-20, third session)**: close the two remaining routing gaps: (1) route code-change intents ("find and fix" / "fix this bug" / "refactor" / "implement" / "diagnose and repair") to autonomous coder CODE_CHANGE mode — NOT deploy-only; (2) add QA_ONLY execution handler that runs targeted module tests; add 8 regression tests; run 2 live certification tests on production; verify 3-way SHA parity
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED means only that a deployment occurred; VERIFIED means acceptance tests passed; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete — must return DEPLOYED_ONLY or NOT_COMPLETED, never DEPLOYED
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; pass `.toString('base64')` gzip string as `content`; **use repo-root relative paths**; for large files (442KB+), write payload to `/tmp/*.json` and use `--data-binary @file` instead of inline `-d`
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; **re-minted this session**)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- Worker job status endpoint returns nested `job` key: `d.get('job')` NOT top-level; result at `job.get('result')`
- Per-owner single-flight: only one active task per owner at a time — QA-only re-run attached to the same stuck code-change task (correct behavior)
- `bun test backend/` = 1709 pass / 0 fail (6230 expects) — updated this session with 11 new certification routing+QA tests
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps; Render propagation takes ~2-4 min across multiple commits
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before tests or tsc

## Progress
### Done
- **CERTIFICATION FIX — DEFECT 1: CODE-CHANGE ROUTING TO AUTONOMOUS CODER — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Root cause: `autonomousCoderTrigger` regex in `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` only matched explicit signals (`autonomous coder`, `code_change`, `write code`, `implement patch`); "find and fix" / "fix this bug" / "refactor" / "implement" fell through to developer_executor → deploy-only redeploy
  - Fix: broadened regex to include `\bfind\s+and\s+fix\b`, `\binspect\s+and\s+fix\b`, `\bfix\s+(?:this|the|a)\s+bug\b`, `\bdiagnose\s+and\s+repair\b`, `\bupdate\s+(?:this|the)\s+module\b`, `\bimplement\s+(?:this|the|a)\s+change\b`, `\brefactor\b`; added `deployOnlyExplicit` guard so "deploy commit <sha>" / "redeploy" routes to developer_executor instead
  - Commits: `83cd9efdf9ec` (routing fix) + `ebbdc7c52d42` (QA race-condition fix)
  - Live-verified: POST "Find and fix one low-risk defect..." → category=senior_developer, MODE=code_change, stage=PATCHING→TESTING — autonomous coder loop invoked, NOT deploy-only

- **CERTIFICATION FIX — DEFECT 2: QA-ONLY EXECUTION HANDLER — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Root cause: QA-only requests created a persistent job but did not run targeted module tests; no `qa_only` execution mode existed in the worker
  - Fix: created `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-qa-runtime.ts` — full QA runtime that extracts module keywords from goal, walks test files, selects matching test files, runs targeted `bun test`, runs scoped typecheck, runs lint, captures exit codes + pass/fail/skip counts + duration; returns BLOCKED with `QA_TARGET_NOT_FOUND` when no module matches; renders owner-mandated 13-section format (TASK ID / MODE / FILES INSPECTED / TESTS SELECTED / COMMANDS RUN / EXIT CODES / PASSED / FAILED / SKIPPED / TYPECHECK / LINT / FINDINGS / STATUS)
  - Wired `qa_only` execution mode into worker: added QA branch in `processNextSeniorDeveloperJob()`, `summarizeQAOnlyProof()`, `qaPhaseToStage()` helper
  - Added QA-only routing block in `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` with `qaOnlyTrigger` regex (run QA / regression / smoke test / quality assurance / pre-flight / pre-submission); fires BEFORE autonomous coder branch; QA + code-change signal → code-change wins
  - Commits: `11b323a86aba` (QA runtime) + `ada4bddd4846` (tests) + `2efbffcc15e3` (worker wiring) + `83cd9efdf9ec` (owner-ai routing) + `ebbdc7c52d42` (race-condition fix)
  - Live-verified: POST "Run QA on the IVX Chat module..." → category=qa, taskId created, status=completed

- **CERTIFICATION FIX — QA-ONLY RACE CONDITION — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED**
  - Same "RUNNING (completed, 100%)" placeholder bug as cert-3B read-only fix: terminal job with null result fell into running branch
  - Fix: added terminal-with-null-result branch in QA-only routing block — renders honest "finalizing evidence" block, never contradictory RUNNING line
  - Commit: `ebbdc7c52d42`

- **11 ROUTING + QA REGRESSION TESTS — ALL PASSING**
  - `backend/ivx-certification-routing-qa.test.ts` — 11 tests (8 owner-mandated + 3 QA handler behavior)
  - TEST 1: "Find and fix" → autonomous coder; TEST 2: "Deploy commit abc123" → deploy-only; TEST 3: "Run QA" → QA-only; TEST 4: "Inspect only" → read-only; TEST 5: no-diff → BLOCKED never redeploy; TEST 6: invalid module → QA_TARGET_NOT_FOUND; TEST 7: one prompt = one task; TEST 8: retry idempotency
  - Full backend regression: 1709 pass / 0 fail (6230 expects)

- **PRIOR SESSION CERTIFICATION DEFECTS (still live):**
  - Defect 1 (cert-3B): read-only inspection "RUN
